 The Houston Texans have been without David Montgomery since the 26-3 Week 5 win over the Tennessee Titans, as he's been dealing with a groin injury. However, it appears his return is nearing, as he provided good news while speaking with media members on Tuesday ahead of the " Thursday Night Football " matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The 29-year-old running back wouldn't outright say if he is or isn't available for the Week 11 contest, but he did admit he's making progress with his injury , according to Aaron Wilson of KCPR 2 Houston. At the very least, Montgomery is glad to be back at practice after missing the past four games.
 "I feel like [I'm] trending in the right direction," Montgomery said. "Just taking it one day at a time. Just happy to be out there with my team, for real."
 Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) 
 The eight-year veteran appeared in five games this season before sustaining the groin injury. However, those performances were not the most productive for Montgomery. So far in his first season with the Texans, Montgomery has recorded 138 yards and two touchdowns off 52 rush attempts. His 27.6 yards-per-game average is on pace for the lowest of his career.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Houston has been leaning on second-year back Woody Marks in David Montgomery's absence. The run game has been a tad bit improved since the first five games of the campaign, but Marks hasn't quite run away with the starting job, having totaled 391 yards and two touchdowns on 107 attempts.
 Click Above to Subscribe The Texans still have some time to evaluate Montgomery before determining his official status for Thursday's game against the Colts. Houston will have until 90 minutes before the 8:15 p.m. EST kickoff time to reveal its final active list.
